verdict.rationale: Reducto's security policy documents a Zero Data Retention policy for Growth tier and above, with API-submitted data auto-deleted within 24 hours. It also states completed SOC 2 Type I and Type II audits, and a HIPAA-compliant processing pipeline with a BAA for Growth and Enterprise customers. VPC and hybrid deployment options add further control for contracts and medical records. Missing for 10: truly immediate (zero-hour) retention rather than a 24-hour expiry window; ZDR coverage for Studio-run and persisted jobs, which are excluded; availability on lower tiers; independent or hands-on corroboration of the ZDR, SOC 2 and HIPAA claims.
